1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。” Formula: Subject + 听说 + 用 + material + 做/泡 + product + 很有用 Correct: “他听说用黄色的花泡茶很有用。” “你跟黄色的花” is not natural here. Use 用 (“use”) to explain the material for making tea.
